question: Can I play a land from my graveyard with mayhem if I have no land plays left this turn?

expected.shortAnswer: No: you can play it with mayhem only if you have an available land play, since playing a land has no cost.
expected.answer: You can play Oscorp Industries using its mayhem ability only if you have available land plays remaining. There's no cost to playing a land; you're simply playing it from your graveyard.
